reference: kemiller2002/limen#50 (LCP-032: a malformed projection cannot partially mutate the current view)
placement: Core (kernel projection mechanism) — atomic application is a property of the one place projections are applied, so it can only be fixed there. Reproduced: a projection whose data-each value was not an array still rewrote an earlier data-text. The kernel now validates a projection completely (bound scopes and not-yet-mounted templates alike) before writing anything; the rules are the ones application already enforced, checked first. No protocol change.
